body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Streaming Networks presented ''iRecord'' that allows users to record video clips directly with their iPod or PSP. If users connect the iRecord to analogue audio/video devices such as TV, DVD, or VCR, video clips being played in those devices are recorded in their iPod or PSP in real time. H.264/AVC video codec and AAC audio codec are utilized.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
